integrity: The proof reduces all non-center vertices to an automatic local condition and isolates the center as the sole global singleton constraint. The spectrum construction and minimum-color enumeration are proved separately, and the checker reconstructs neighborhoods directly.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to friendship graphs and ordinary proper conflict-free coloring.
The minimum-color enumeration treats colors as labeled and does not quotient by graph automorphisms or color permutations.
The finite verifier is corroborative; arbitrary k is established analytically.
A 2026 P4-sparse upper-bound paper was inspectable only through its abstract and metadata, leaving a residual risk of an unindexed friendship-specific scalar example.
title: Proper conflict-free colorings of friendship graphs
